summary: Read hash-bound handoff and both artifacts; independently checked canonical OSReset.c and rendered view. Both proposed corrections match finalization ordering, selective cancellation and padcal lifetime. Existing supported names and inherited retained knowledge remain unchanged. All upstream non-retain claims reconciled; section/layout and cross-file uncertainties accepted as explicit deferrals.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical control flow confirms LCDisable precedes the final-success assertion, cancellation selects numeric states 1 and 4, and only mode 2 initializes padcal. Five cleanup ranges and the conditional returning-reboot caveat are accurate. The callback helper aggregates callback and SRAM failures; assembly Reset is terminal. The proposal and functionality document agree.

The file-level correction accurately summarizes the same phase ordering and mode-dependent saved-state lifetime. Cleanup has no local interrupt or scheduler restoration; mode 0 enables scheduling before calling __OSReboot, as separately stated. No unsupported symbolic thread-state or compiled-behavior interpretation is introduced.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the six .sbss facts and associated implements link: source establishes the intrusive ResetFunctionQueue and its reset-coordination role, but not generic section identity, eight-byte compiled extent, or layout. Existing source-level queue knowledge remains supported independently.

For fact:8e1b2b4c-d6e0-43f1-a85e-cb3f299b3047, accept the additional mutation-safety qualification: traversal itself does not modify membership, but calls external callbacks before reading info->next. This does not establish arbitrary callback-driven mutation safety.

The supersession of fact:61a1b13a-f431-4336-bcda-d6af375478be is justified: locked cache is disabled before asserting final callback success. Exceptional fallthrough can use padcal without local initialization; the correction appropriately avoids claiming compiled consequences.

The supersession of fact:78eb5629-e288-4507-985a-50b1b57be4e8 is justified: cancellation is selective and restoration has a saved value only for mode 2. Accept explicit deferral of symbolic state meanings and the cross-file non-returning contract of __OSReboot; the proposal preserves the conditional return path rather than assuming it is reachable.
